scope.name: Live Studio Integration
in_scope: mount the existing FGA-04 Fashion Design Studio in an authorized real Creator product surface
establish explicit local FDE design-session ownership over the existing FGA-04 runtime without duplicating FGA authority
wire preview-view switching, undo, redo, revert, save, load and CAS-WARD-001 wardrobe-proposal actions
surface explicit provider-off/fit/coverage state and preserve authorization/recovery boundaries
retire the stale FGA-06 remaining-work validation marker and activate an FDE-01 validation profile
focused integration tests proving the live Creator path exposes the Fashion Design Studio only after authorized Creator entry
out_of_scope: FDE-02 detailed designer controls or production garment catalog
Mall, marketplace, commerce or public sharing
equipment truth, anatomy or mechanics mutation
